args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring (and FIN-212) specify banker's rounding, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the quantize call to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.665 rounds to 2.66 and 2.675 rounds to 2.68,
as tests/test_money.py expects.

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` rounded with `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite the docstring and FIN-212 specifying banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), causing the nightly `tests/test_money.py` failure (e.g. 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66).
- Switched the `quantize` call to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so ties round to the nearest even cent.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit 08d3cd5986 passed (`tests/test_money.py` green).
